'''Tahji Panagakos''' was an orphan living in [[Cjaalysce'I]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Arriving on the planet after stowing away on a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], Panagakos made a living as a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] and messenger for Cjaalysce'I's businesses. The city's [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] "adopted" Panagakos, making sure she always had clothes, food and shelter.<ref name="BSS" />
